name: cal-val-data
title: Calibration and Validation Dataset
description: Model agnostic calibration and validation data. Tables mirror the workbook tabs and are generated by scripts/ingest.R, with stable text keys instead of database identifiers. Validation runs in warn mode (scripts/validate.R): known curation gaps warn, they do not fail. Date columns are kept as strings because current export mixes ISO, YYYYMMDD, and excel serial encodings; normalize on ingest.

licenses.name: BSD-3-Clause
licenses.title: code (scripts, tests) is BSD-3-Clause; curated data may carry CC-BY from upstream sources, cite data/citations.csv

fields.name: longitude

fields.name: end_date

fields.name: treatment_name

fields.name: citation_id

fields.name: treatment_id_2

fields.name: comparison_factor

fields.name: healthy_soils_practice

fields.name: treatments.name
fields.description: foreign key to treatments.name; one treatment per row

fields.name: min_date

fields.name: max_date

fields.name: mgmttype

fields.name: cover_crop

fields.name: attributes_keyvalue
fields.description: semicolon-delimited key=value; key=value; carries material, N content, implement, timing, etc

fields.name: exact_date
fields.description: flag for whether the reported date is exact rather than a window or an estimate

fields.name: estimated
fields.description: whether the event timing or amount was estimated rather than reported

fields.name: citation_id
fields.description: citation this event was drawn from; refers to citations.citation_id, not a DOI

fields.name: relative_timing
fields.description: timing relative to another event where no calendar date is given, e.g. after_planting

fields.name: relative_timing_days

fields.name: reported_amount
fields.description: amount as the source reports it, in `reported_units`

fields.name: reported_units
fields.description: units of `reported_amount`, as reported

fields.name: reported_material
fields.description: material applied or removed, as the source describes it

fields.name: crop_display
fields.description: crop label as the source displays it

fields.name: depth_m
fields.description: depth of the event in metres, where the source gives one

fields.name: intensity_category
fields.description: qualitative intensity of the event, e.g. intensive, recurring, seasonal

fields.name: method_id

fields.name: attributes_json
fields.description: JSON object carrying source specific fields with no column of their own

fields.name: min_date
fields.description: earliest plausible date; mixed encodings in current export, ##TODO normalize

fields.name: max_date
fields.description: latest plausible date; equals min_date for point samples; blank when source gives no window

fields.name: crop
fields.description: crop the row relates to, where recorded: the harvested crop on yield and biomass rows, the crop at the site on flux and soil rows; mostly a common name (e.g. corn, rice), but Modesto rows hold Prunus dulcis and Russell Ranch cover crop rows winter_cover_crop, so values do not all match crops

fields.name: variety
fields.description: crop cultivar where the source reports one, e.g. rice M-206; blank on most rows

fields.name: sitename
fields.description: foreign key to sites.name

fields.name: variable
fields.description: foreign key to variables.name

fields.name: method
fields.description: method key; every value matches a `method name` in methods

fields.name: value
fields.description: measured value in reported_units

fields.name: n
fields.description: sample size; 1 for replicate-level rows

fields.name: statname
fields.description: statistic name on summary rows, e.g. SE; blank for replicate rows

fields.name: stat
fields.description: statistic value; SD is not converted to SE during curation

fields.name: treatment_id
fields.description: foreign key to treatments.name

fields.name: replicate_id
fields.description: replicate label as the source uses it; numeric at some sites, lettered blocks or named zones at others

fields.name: study_year
fields.description: experiment year (White 0-8) or calendar year (Nichols 2019); mixed semantics

fields.name: min_depth
fields.description: cm; sampled interval for depth-based observations; reference interval for equivalent-soil-mass stocks

fields.name: max_depth
fields.description: cm; sampled interval for depth-based observations; reference interval for equivalent-soil-mass stocks, with actual integrated depth in attributes_json.equivalent_depth_cm

fields.name: citation
fields.description: DOI; foreign key to citations.doi

fields.name: fill_status
fields.description: provenance / source-precedence code; blank allowed for now

fields.name: notes
fields.description: free text on the row, e.g. source table or figure, date precision, measurement support (chamber or tower) and any correction applied; Russell Ranch total C and N rows carry only a label such as east_side_compilation

fields.name: dataset_id
fields.description: short source-packet id, e.g. white_salinas_2020

fields.name: reported_units
fields.description: units as reported by the source

fields.name: observation_level
fields.description: experimental unit the row represents

fields.name: citation_id
fields.description: citation this observation was drawn from; refers to citations.citation_id, not a DOI

fields.name: data_origin
fields.description: how the value was obtained, e.g. publication_table, publication_text, scripted aggregation

fields.name: flags
fields.description: quality flags carried from the producing workflow, e.g. QC_PASS_YEAR

fields.name: attributes_json
fields.description: JSON object carrying source specific fields with no column of their own

fields.name: source_table
fields.description: table or sheet within the source the row came from

fields.name: method name
fields.description: method key and primary key; observations.method holds these values. Snake case for most rows (e.g. static_chamber_N2O), a plain title for some (e.g. Eddy covariance daily)

fields.name: description
fields.description: must state dry vs wet basis and volumetric vs mass basis where relevant

fields.name: citation_id
fields.description: DOI of the method source; foreign key to citations.doi

fields.name: method_id
fields.description: stable identifier for the method, where the source workbook carries one

fields.name: short_name
fields.description: short human readable method label

fields.name: notes
fields.description: free text qualifier on the method

fields.name: attributes_json
fields.description: JSON object carrying source specific fields with no column of their own

fields.name: name
fields.description: variable key; observations.variable refers to it. A snake case name, often ending in its unit (e.g. SOC_stock_Mg_ha), or a PEcAn standard name (e.g. NEE, SoilTemp); where one name covers several AmeriFlux sensor series, the series follows a double underscore (e.g. SoilTemp__TS_1_1_1)

fields.name: description
fields.description: plain English definition of the variable, with basis, extraction method or depth handling where it matters

fields.name: units
fields.description: units the variable is expressed in; `source-reported units` where they vary by source, and separate daily and annual units for some flux variables. A row's own unit is observations.reported_units, which can differ (e.g. CH4_flux)

fields.name: notes
fields.description: free text on the variable: source, level, systems and years covered for curated targets, or the PEcAn standard name mapping and AmeriFlux source variable for flux and weather series

fields.name: scientific name
fields.description: scientific name of the crop and primary key; a cover crop mix lists each taxon separated by ' / ' (e.g. Vicia villosa / Secale cereale)

fields.name: common name
fields.description: common name of the crop or cover crop mix, e.g. romaine lettuce, almond, legume-rye mix

fields.name: notes
fields.description: variety and per-crop management notes

resources.name: coverage
resources.description: coverage planning matrix: system and treatment contrast against each target, split into magnitude and treatment contrast. Workbook tab carries a multi row title preamble above header; ingest must skip preamble so these field names land on header row.

fields.name: System
fields.description: cropping system the row covers (e.g. Annual row / vegetable, Rice / flooded); below the MVP Coverage Guidance heading row it holds a guidance topic instead (e.g. Core outputs, CH4); blank on the per site row count rows

fields.name: Treatment contrast
fields.description: management contrast the row covers (e.g. Cover crop vs no cover crop, Tillage contrast); on guidance rows, the guidance text for the topic in `System`

fields.name: ΔSOC magnitude
fields.description: 1 if the workbook marks the absolute change in soil organic carbon (ΔSOC) as covered for this system and contrast, 0 if not; as recorded, not checked against observations

fields.name: ΔSOC treatment contrast
fields.description: 1 if the workbook marks the treatment difference in ΔSOC as covered for this system and contrast, 0 if not; as recorded, not checked against observations

fields.name: N2O magnitude
fields.description: 1 if the workbook marks absolute N2O flux as covered for this system and contrast, 0 if not; as recorded, not checked against observations

fields.name: N2O treatment contrast
fields.description: 1 if the workbook marks the treatment difference in N2O flux as covered for this system and contrast, 0 if not; as recorded, not checked against observations

fields.name: CH4 magnitude
fields.description: 1 if the workbook marks absolute CH4 flux as covered for this system and contrast, 0 if not; as recorded, not checked against observations

fields.name: CH4 treatment contrast
fields.description: 1 if the workbook marks the treatment difference in CH4 flux as covered for this system and contrast, 0 if not; as recorded, not checked against observations

fields.name: Woody Biomass magnitude
fields.description: 1 if the workbook marks absolute woody biomass as covered for this system and contrast, 0 if not; one Rice / flooded row holds X, whose meaning the workbook does not state; as recorded, not checked against observations

fields.name: Initial data sources
fields.description: free text naming the datasets used or planned for this system and contrast, e.g. White/Salinas, Nichols 2024, TBD

fields.name: Notes
fields.description: free text on the system and contrast row, e.g. strength of the contrast or what the source lacks; the per site row count rows use lowercase `notes` instead

fields.name: site_id
fields.description: site the counts apply to; refers to sites.name

fields.name: variable
fields.description: variable the counts apply to; refers to variables.name

fields.name: daily_rows
fields.description: count of daily rows available for this site and variable

fields.name: annual_rows
fields.description: count of annual rows available for this site and variable

fields.name: seasonal_rows
fields.description: count of seasonal rows available for this site and variable

fields.name: static_observation_rows
fields.description: count of static (single time point) observation rows

fields.name: weather_rows
fields.description: count of weather rows available for the site

fields.name: notes
fields.description: free text qualifier on the coverage row
